name: Balnarring Bakehouse
address: Balnarring Village Shopping Centre, 3050 Frankston-Flinders Rd, Balnarring VIC 3926
signature: The village bakehouse for the Balnarring side of the Peninsula, pies, pastries, and the breakfast sandwich that fuels the Saturday market crowd.
editorNote:
Balnarring Bakehouse is the village bakery the Balnarring side of the Peninsula has relied on for years. The pies and pastries are proper country-bakery standard, a solid beef-and-mushroom, an honest custard tart, a vanilla slice that will not disappoint anyone over the age of eight, and the weekend breakfast sandwich has become the quiet fuel source for half the Balnarring Market crowd on a Saturday morning.

There is nothing aspirational about the room. That is exactly why it works. Go on a Saturday morning, grab a coffee and a breakfast sandwich, and walk across to the market with one hand on the paper bag. The Heritage, the village pub, is a short walk up Frankston-Flinders Road for when the market is done and you want to sit down properly.

A reliable anchor for any Balnarring-side weekend. The kind of bakery that holds a village together.
whyWeGo: The honest country bakery the Balnarring side relies on, exactly what it is, no more, and that is the whole point.
ifOnlyOneThing: Order a pie and a sweet pastry and eat at least one of them while it is still warm.

closureNote: Checked 2026-09-13. The address is not an error: 3050 Frankston-Flinders Rd is the street address of the Balnarring Village Shopping Centre (https://balnarring-vic.aussiestoresonline.com/balnarring-village-shopping-centre/), and a Balnarring Bakehouse is listed there by Tripadvisor as Balnarring Bakehouse Bakery and Cafe, Russell Street, Balnarring Village Shopping Centre (https://www.tripadvisor.com.au/Restaurant_Review-g1066997-d15767989-Reviews-Balnarring_Bakehouse_Bakery_and_Cafe-Balnarring_Mornington_Peninsula_Victoria.html) and in a centre store directory last updated 2022 (https://www.australia-shoppings.com/malls-centres/victoria/balnarring/balnarring-village-shopping-centre). Coordinates corrected to the OpenStreetMap address node for 3050 Frankston-Flinders Rd; the earlier point sat about 1.2 km east of the village. Current trading is not confirmed: the business has no operator site, the listed phone for that listing (03 5983 1494) is also carried by a Balnarring Takeaway at Shop 9 of the same centre (https://restaurantguru.com/Conroys-Bakehouse-Balnarring) whose newest reviews are about three years old, and the phone number previously recorded here (+61 3 5983 5060) could not be tied to the business, so it was removed rather than replaced. The Red Hill Baker trades at 1/3000 Frankston-Flinders Rd (https://www.redhillbaker.com.au/) and is a different business. The specific menu items in this record's copy (pies, custard tart, vanilla slice, breakfast sandwich) are not evidenced by any source found. Unresolved.
